Body.Content:
App Service on Linux now supports Apache Tomcat and Java SE applications, making it easier and quicker to build, deploy and scale Java web apps, API and Spring-based applications. Read to learn more about Tomcat & Java SE on App Service.

 

With Azul Zulu Enterprise builds of OpenJDK on Azure and Azure Stack, Java developers and enterprises will receive timely security updates and bug fixes for free - no additional licensing and support costs. Read to learn more about Java SE support on Azure and Azure Stack
